# Kemcon

> Egyptian manufacturer of premium home textiles and furnishings since 1985, supplying hotels and hospitality projects across the MENA region.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://kemcon.site/en): Overview of Kemcon's products and services
- [Products](https://kemcon.site/en/products): Product catalog and fabric showroom — the front door to every category
- [Curtains](https://kemcon.site/en/products/curtains): Bespoke curtains — layers, measurements, opening method, fabric treatments
- [Chairs](https://kemcon.site/en/products/chairs): Hospitality-grade seating, configurable frame and upholstery
- [Sofas](https://kemcon.site/en/products/sofas): Custom sofas with choice of fabric and frame finish
- [Bed Covers](https://kemcon.site/en/products/bed-covers): Bed covers and matching pillows in Egyptian cotton and luxury blends
- [Custom Pieces](https://kemcon.site/en/products/custom): Anything outside the standard categories, made to a description
- [Design Plan](https://kemcon.site/en/products/design-plan): End-to-end design planning for hospitality projects
- [Mass Production](https://kemcon.site/en/products/mass-production): Large-scale manufacturing for hotel outfitting
- [About](https://kemcon.site/en/about): Company history, values, and manufacturing capabilities
- [Clients](https://kemcon.site/en/clients): Hotels and resorts Kemcon has supplied
- [Contact](https://kemcon.site/en/contact): Contact details, showroom location, and enquiry form

Every page is also published in Arabic at the same path under `/ar`.

## Product lines

Kemcon manufactures fully customisable textiles and furniture for the hospitality industry:

- **Curtains** — sheer, decorative and blackout layers, manual or remote-controlled
- **Chairs** — hospitality-grade seating with configurable frame material and finish
- **Sofas** — custom upholstery with choice of fabric and frame finish
- **Bed Covers** — Egyptian cotton, percale, sateen and luxury blends, with matching pillows
- **Custom** — pieces described by the client and quoted individually

Fabric treatments available across textile categories: anti-fungal and
antibacterial, fire-retardant (burn-treated), and stain-resistant.

## How to order

There is no online checkout. Each category page carries a short enquiry form —
quantity, the kind of property being furnished, one product question, and
contact details — which reaches the Kemcon team directly. Orders spanning
several categories can be combined into a single brief, and hotels ordering at
volume can use the mass-production page instead.

## About

Kemcon has been manufacturing since 1985, headquartered in Cairo, Egypt. The
company serves major hotel brands across Egypt, Saudi Arabia, the UAE and
Jordan, delivering complete room outfitting from design through mass production.
